notes.title: Farming Isles 1.0.3 update
notes.content:
- Included version numbers to help track. Currently at version 1.0.3

[u]New features[/u]
- Added in auto-saving! Every 12 hours in game will make an auto-save. The game will also auto-save after beating The Vermins in the minigames.
- Added in a save backup button at the main menu, it will make a copy of the save file. Clicking the button again will overwrite the BACKUP save file. Only save.save will be read when starting the game.

[u]UI Changes[/u]
- Pressing tab opens and closes the farm stats menu.
- Fixed the possibility of opened the seed selection and tool bar select menu at the same time. Can no longer have the market menu and farm stats menu open at the same time.
- Added tool text to identify what which tool is which when selecting a tool.
- Updated the pause menu controls to include the new features.
- Adjusted the seed count in the seed selection menu to not overflow.

[u]Structure Changes[/u]
- Solar Panel nerfs: 
	- upgrade costs increased to $850 per upgrade tier 
	- reduced base earnings to $50 with an increase per level +$25/$35/$45
	- selling value increased to from $175 -> $475 per tier. 
	- Solar Panel will only collect money once per day at 12pm in game.
- When buying a structure, it will now allow for multiple purchases of the same structure. Press the Cancel button, pressing the Escape key or press Right Mouse Button to return to the shop menu. 

[u]Isle Changes[/u]
- Bog Isle now reduces water usage by half the amount needed per growth stage (ie: 4 watered needed => 4/2 = 2 water needed per stage).

[u]Minigame Changes[/u]
- Fix an error while in the minigames. If the player had the Farm Stats or the Farm Market menu opened while transitioning to the mini games loop, player could press Escape key to bring back the player ui elements. Leading to the ability to open the pause menu and exiting the minigames. This also permanently stopping the Vandals from spawning.
- Fixed an issue with Where's the Box that ended the game prematurely resulting in the player automatically winning.
- Fixed the minigames tutorials, when resetting them, the third page of the tutorial would still be active, they now all reset to the first tutorial page for each minigame.
- Temporarily disabled Mr. Swiss Higher or Lower minigame as it could potentially lead to a soft-lock if played. This will make the Slots minigame the only playable for the time being with Mr. Swiss.

Happy Farming!

notes.title: Farming Isles update March 14
notes.content:
[h2]Patches[/h2]

- Desert Isle and Solar Panel saving error have been fixed.
- Right clicking with the Harvest Tool while hovering over the Farmland itself will now harvest all crops that are ready.
- Moved the Info Tool UI to the left side to reduce overlapping of the UI interactions
- Zooming out the camera has been increased, you can now see much more.
- Fixed the Starting Isle to properly give the player 100 free crop storage. This could have lead to a soft lock if no Crop Silo was built.

Happy farming!

notes.title: First fixes!
notes.content:
[h1]The following are the first few fixes to Farming Isles.[/h1]

- Nerf Corn selling prices and yields. Selling from $7-$11 > $5-$7, now yields 2-4 corn.
- Fixed the Farm Market to properly update the selling price and multipliers.
- Temporarily removed Solar Panels from the structures as it can cause an issue with the save file
(saving and loading a few times will result in loss of structures on other Isles). Working on a fix to bring it back.
- Increased camera base and while holding 'left shift' move speed.
- The Vandal attack button will now move to the next structure that is under attack.
- Updated pause menu to now show the keybinds. (Yes... the keybinds still show when quitting game. Will be fixed next update).


More updates will be coming to improve QoL and gameplay.

Happy farming!
